messages:
kevin: quick heads-up — planning to run the sunflower canary for 1.18.0 tomorrow 08:00 PST. can someone own the deploy window?

sameer: I can take deploy lead. I'll be online from 07:30 for prechecks. :+1:

olivia: I'll do smoke tests post-deploy (api + auth flows). slack me when canary hits 1%.

kevin: thanks. rollout plan: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% over ~45m with health gates. full list in the mini plan below.

maria: sending the cohort mapping and target hosts now. pinging infra to keep extra capacity ready.

maria: ```yaml
cohorts:
  - name: pilot-1pct
    selector: region=us-west-2, bucket=sunflower-1
    percent: 1
  - name: regional-5pct
    selector: region=us-west-2, bucket=sunflower-2
    percent: 4
  - name: scale-20pct
    selector: geo=us, cohort_tag=scale-a
    percent: 15
```

zack: quick checklist for leads: 
- preflight run by 07:40 (smoketest script)
- DS and SLO dashboards open
- rollback command ready in chat

jen: rollback command (QA verified): `kubectl rollout undo deployment/redwood-api --to-revision=2023 --namespace=prod`

kevin: health gates: p95 latency increase < 15%, error-rate < 0.5% absolute increase, no spike in auth 5xx. If any gate fails, pause and revert to previous variant.

sameer: I'll run the gradual ramps. plan for 5m at 1%, if green -> to 5% and then monitor for 10m.

olivia: smoke script summary (will run after each ramp):
1) login -> create session
2) simple generate prompt -> validate token stream
3) embed API quick hash check
4) latency sample of 50 requests

kevin: monitoring to watch: `svc/redwood-api:latency_p95`, `svc/redwood-api:error_rate`, `infra/gpu_util`, `auth/5xx_rate`. sre-bot will post alerts.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled canary for 1.18.0 at 2026-03-18T08:00:00-08:00. Owners: sameer (deploy), olivia (smoke), maria (cohorts). :rocket:

maria: tagging support: @oncall-eng in case we need quick rollback assistance.

zack: last-minute note — feature flag will be toggled at the router level; make sure consumers with older clients are excluded from cohorts.

jen: I've got the rollback artifact pinned. if we need to revert, I'll coordinate the image rollback and config restore.

kevin: perfect. final preflight tomorrow 07:45 in this thread. call out blockers early. thanks everyone :handshake:
